name: Ai Suru Tsuma ga Me no Mae de Tanin Bou ni Tsuranukare, Yogari Aeide Iku. Gomennasai Anata. Demo, Watashi Kimochi Ii no...
original_name: 愛する妻が目の前で他人棒に貫かれ、よがり喘いでいく。 ゴメンなさいあなた。でも、私気持ちいいの……
source: A young couple travels to an underground resort, but they get trapped there with a creepy janitor.
